name: discover_schema
description: Discover and introspect database schema including tables, columns, data types, relationships, and low-cardinality values. Stores metadata in Cosmos DB for semantic search.

return_type.description: Schema discovery results with table count, column count, and relationships found

examples.description: Discover all tables and columns in the database

safety_guidelines: May take time for large databases
Run periodically or when schema changes
